risk_note: RV2 by the risk map (apps/app.module.ts is outside the allow-list; the code is in the agent module, RV1). Admin Agent trace query, D1 part 1 (D10-1310): adminListAgentSessions and adminGetAgentSession leave planned (the two report operations stay planned). agent.trace only, no step-up; every successful detail read appends one audit agent_trace_view (target agent_sessions:<id>, before / after null, no message text or tool arguments); list, 10403 and 20001 write none. Every query filters by app_id; unknown, other-app and malformed session ids answer the same 20001 [session_id]. No phone, device_id, user_hash, app_id or user_text in either response; pii.* changes nothing. expired = expired_at set and <= now, or last_active_at + 24 h <= now (BR-AI-20), injected Clock. cost_mfen goes through fenToJsonNumber (BR-CALC-01, no silent rounding). Read-only: no new column, no migration; agent/stream/**, agent/http/index.ts, agent/store/index.ts, agent/store/results/**, agent.module.ts and modules/admin/** untouched (agreed with agent2). Host: integration spec/agent/admin-traces + spec/feedback/admin-product-feedbacks 23/23, test/spec/contracts 600/600, apps/api unit 5139 pass, tsc / contracts:check / depcruise 0. After the first CI run: the controller holds only agent-built reader functions, never the database handle (frozen [AC-B3-08k#1] green, 20/20); integration spec/agent/admin-traces re-run 14/14.
